Context: (g) LTC during study leave.-

## (g) LTC during study leave.-  
- (i) For self.Government servant can avail LTC from place of study to home town I any place in India but reimbursement will be restricted to fare admissible between headquarters and home town/ place of visit or actual expenditure, whichever is less.
- (ii) For family members.When family members are residing with the Government servant at the place of his study leave same as for self.
